paper_title: Identified Hadron Production in Deeply Inelastic Neutrino-Nucleon Scattering
paper_region: x > 0.1, W > 3 GeV, on a proton; their Fig. 4 is at E_nu ~ 300 GeV

regions.label: Q2 > 4 GeV2, W > 3 GeV (the benchmark region)

target: tungsten, 74 p + 110 n per nucleus, from the proton and neutron samples (faser_pions.combine)

sidis_w.label: Q2 > 4 GeV2, W > 3 GeV (the benchmark region)
sidis_w.normalisation: YADISM NLO (ZM-VFNS, TMC) shape of the benchmark region x this generator's ratio at 20, 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 700, 1000, 2000, 4000 GeV

selection.name: sidis_w
selection.label: Q2 > 4 GeV2 + W > 3 GeV
selection.note: Our own region with no detector tier and no x cut: the fiducial region the paper is eventually to adopt (TODO.md). The pion multiplicity is quoted here as well as on the paper's region, so the effect of their x floor on a multiplicity is a measured number.

pion_presence.note: 1 - P(no charged pion). any_z: any charged pion in the event; zcut: one above z = 0.1; zcut_emulsion: one above z = 0.1 inside tan(theta) < 0.5. The top-level values are flux averaged with the same weights as the yields.
